text: ねえさんと　ボクと　いっしょに　たたかって！

structure.jp: ねえさんと　ボクと

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a casual request, short for てください. たたかって = 'battle, please'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: ねえさんと　ボクと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: といっしょに after people means 'together with' them. ねえさんと　ボクと　いっしょに = 'together with my sister and me'.
